title: Indemnity Form
subtitle: (Consolidated Form B and Form C)
sources: Form B: Digital Indemnity & Scholar Code of Conduct

sections.heading: Participation and Booking Details
sections.body: This form applies to the Job Shadow experience identified in the booking details below. The scholar or tertiary student consents to taking part. Where the participant is a minor under applicable law, their parent or legal guardian must also consent and sign this form from their own linked account. The parent or legal guardian confirms that they are authorised to act for the participant.

sections.heading: Educational Nature of the Experience
sections.body: Job Shadow (Pty) Ltd provides educational career exploration. It is not acting as an employment, recruitment or employment placement agency. Participation is unpaid and does not constitute an offer of employment, an internship or a learnership. The participant will observe a professional workplace under the supervision of a mentor. Reasonable precautions will be taken for their safety, but an active workplace involves ordinary, inherent risks, including risks associated with travel to and from the location.

sections.heading: Code of Conduct and Confidentiality
sections.body: The participant agrees to arrive punctually at the confirmed location, follow the mentor's or company's dress code, and comply with reasonable instructions from assigned mentors and company personnel. The participant must follow all site security, safety and emergency procedures. They must respect confidential information, client privacy and intellectual property, and must not take photographs or make video or audio recordings without permission.

sections.heading: Parent or Guardian Health and Emergency Consent
sections.body: For a minor participant, the parent or legal guardian confirms that the medical, emergency and contact information supplied to Job Shadow (Pty) Ltd is accurate and that any medical condition that could affect participation has been disclosed. If a medical emergency occurs and the parent or legal guardian cannot be contacted promptly, they authorise the mentor or company to arrange necessary emergency medical treatment for the participant at their expense. An adult tertiary student provides their own health information and emergency-treatment consent.

sections.heading: Parent or Guardian Acknowledgement of Risk and Indemnity
sections.body: For a minor participant, the parent or legal guardian acknowledges the ordinary, inherent risks of attending a workplace and travelling to and from it. To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, the parent or legal guardian, in their own capacity and on behalf of the minor, releases, indemnifies and holds harmless Job Shadow (Pty) Ltd, its directors, employees and representatives, the individual mentor, and the host company and its employees and representatives against claims, loss, injury, illness or damage arising from participation or related travel. This does not exclude liability for gross negligence, wilful misconduct or a breach of statutory duties, or limit rights that cannot lawfully be excluded. These parent or guardian undertakings are accepted through the parent's own signature; the scholar's signature does not substitute for it. An adult tertiary student gives the applicable acknowledgements and indemnity in their own capacity.

sections.heading: Photography and Video
sections.body: Photography or video for Job Shadow's records and photography or video for promotional use require the separate permissions selected below. Permission for promotional use is optional and is not a condition of booking or participation. Where the participant is a minor, the linked parent or legal guardian must make the applicable permission choices. Permission for Job Shadow records: Allow / Do not allow. Permission for promotional use: Allow / Do not allow. No permission is assumed when a choice has not been made.

sections.heading: Separate Declarations and Digital Signatures
sections.body: Each required signer must sign their own declaration from their own account. The platform records each signature separately with the authenticated signer's user ID, exact form version, date and time, and available IP address. The scholar cannot sign the parent or guardian's declaration.

scholar_declaration: I confirm that my information is accurate, that I understand the educational nature of this experience, and that I agree to the code of conduct, confidentiality and site safety requirements. If I am an adult tertiary student, I also give the applicable consent and indemnity in my own capacity.
parent_declaration: I confirm that I am authorised to act for the minor. I consent to their attendance and the emergency medical arrangements, confirm the health and contact information supplied, and accept the parent or guardian acknowledgements and indemnity above. I make the applicable photography choices separately.
